Add the date and time to a file name

timestamped_path.Rd

Adds the current time to a file name, for example report.docx becomes report_20261127_093015.docx, so each output is kept and the input is never overwritten. If a file with that name already exists (for example two outputs made in the same second), a counter is added: report_20261127_093015_2.docx.

Usage

timestamped_path(path, time = Sys.time(), format = "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

Arguments

path

Path to the file the name is based on. Only its folder, base name and extension are used.

time

The time to stamp. Defaults to now.

format

A strftime() format for the stamp. Defaults to "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S".

Value

A path that does not yet exist.

See also

Other versions: latest_word_file()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
out <- timestamped_path("output/report.docx")
} # }
